description: This file contains PHP unit tests for the EmployeeTimesheetAPI class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It verifies API endpoints such as create, getAll, update, and also tests for unimplemented methods like getOne and delete. The class employs data providers, fixture setup, and mock services to simulate various test scenarios.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeTimesheetAPI, testing various API methods including create, getAll, update, and handling of unimplemented methods.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new employee timesheet via the API using provided test case parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the create API test, retrieving data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all employee timesheets via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the getAll API test.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing employee timesheet via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the update API test.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Verifies that calling getOne() throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Verifies that getValidationRuleForGetOne() throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that delete() method throws a not implemented exception.
